subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should this issue wait for a redacted failed request/response capture before OpenClaw adds any strict-minimal completions mode or new per-provider feature-disabling config?
rationale: The remaining evidence proves partial hardenings and a plausible source path, but not which outbound field or response shape still breaks the reporter's proxy; adding a strict-minimal mode or config knob expands provider behavior policy.

options.title: Request capture first
options.body: Ask for the failed current-main outbound request body plus proxy status/body, then decide between targeted sanitizer, logging, docs, or strict-minimal mode.

options.title: Sponsor strict-minimal mode now
options.body: A maintainer can choose to add an explicit compatibility mode despite incomplete proxy proof, accepting the new config and upgrade surface.

options.title: Close only after no-repro proof
options.body: If the reporter or maintainer verifies the same proxy now completes on current main, close this as already addressed by the landed hardenings.

recommendation.title: Request capture first
recommendation.body: Ask for the failed current-main outbound request body plus proxy status/body, then decide between targeted sanitizer, logging, docs, or strict-minimal mode.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee for this issue and is the best current owner for the product/evidence call.
